about_zh: 把东西跑起来、跑稳：容器、部署、CI、监控。

repos.description: A list of Free Software network services and web applications which can be hosted on your own servers
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个全面的自托管开源软件目录，涵盖通信、存储、管理、媒体等数十个类别，提供替代SaaS的私有化部署方案。核心价值在于帮助用户实现数据主权、隐私保护和基础设施自主可控。项目持续维护，包含死链检查和活跃度监控，是自建服务器的终极参考指南。
repos.summary_en: A comprehensive directory of self-hostable open-source network services and web applications spanning communications, storage, management, media, and dozens of categories. It enables private deployment alternatives to SaaS, empowering data sovereignty, privacy protection, and infrastructure autonomy. Continuously maintained with automated dead link validation and project health monitoring, it serves as the definitive reference for building and maintaining a self-hosted server ecosystem.

repos.description: A list of SaaS, PaaS and IaaS offerings that have free tiers of interest to devops and infradev
repos.summary_zh: free-for-dev 是专为 DevOps 和基础设施开发者打造的免费服务精选清单，聚合主流云厂商、CI/CD、监控、数据库等20+类别 SaaS/PaaS/IaaS 永久免费层。由1600+社区贡献者维护，提供可立即使用的技术栈参考，规避免费试用陷阱，助力开发者快速构建和运维低成本技术架构。
repos.summary_en: free-for-dev is a curated list of free-tier SaaS, PaaS, and IaaS offerings specifically for DevOps and infrastructure developers. It aggregates permanently free services across 20+ categories including major cloud providers, CI/CD, monitoring, databases, and generative AI. Maintained by 1,600+ contributors, it provides immediate technical stack references, helps avoid free-trial traps, and enables building cost-effective architectures with confidence.

repos.description: π RuView turns commodity WiFi signals into real-time spatial intelligence, vital sign monitoring, and presence detection — all without a single pixel of video.
repos.summary_zh: RuView利用商用WiFi的CSI信道状态信息，通过物理信号处理和机器学习实现穿墙人体感知。系统提供实时姿态估计(54K fps)、呼吸心率监测及毫秒级存在检测，无需摄像头或穿戴设备。基于Rust构建，支持ESP32-S3等低成本硬件，适用于智能安防、健康监护及灾难救援等隐私敏感场景。
repos.summary_en: RuView transforms commodity WiFi CSI signals into real-time human perception through physics-based signal processing and ML. It delivers 54K fps pose estimation, vital sign monitoring (breathing/heartbeat), and <1ms presence detection without cameras or wearables. Built in Rust with 1100+ tests, it supports ESP32-S3 and research NICs for through-wall sensing up to 5m. Ideal for privacy-preserving smart home, healthcare, security, and disaster response applications.

repos.description: Programmer's guide about how to cook at home.
repos.summary_zh: 专为程序员设计的开源烹饪指南，采用代码思维重构菜谱结构。每道菜都有精确的食材清单、标准化步骤和量化参数，如同编写程序般严谨。项目集成Docker部署、CI/CD自动化、PDF导出等工程化特性，并建立完整贡献体系。通过技术隐喻和结构化文档，将烹饪转化为可编程的确定性过程，降低程序员下厨门槛。
repos.summary_en: An open-source cooking guide specifically designed for programmers, reconstructing recipes with code-like thinking. Each dish features precise ingredient lists, standardized procedures, and quantified cooking parameters as rigorously as writing code. The project includes engineering features like Docker deployment, CI/CD automation, and PDF export, with a complete contribution system. Through technical metaphors and structured documentation, it transforms cooking into a programmable deterministic process, lowering the barrier for programmers to cook at home.

repos.description: Windows inside a Docker container.
repos.summary_zh: dockur/windows 仓库提供 Docker 镜像，在容器内运行完整 Windows 操作系统。集成 ISO 自动下载、KVM 硬件加速和 Web 远程查看器，支持 Win11/10/服务器等多版本。通过 Docker Compose、CLI 或 Kubernetes 快速部署，适用于开发测试、遗留软件兼容、云原生 Windows 应用托管等场景。亮点包括全自动安装流程、硬件加速及多平台集成，极大简化 Windows 虚拟化部署。
repos.summary_en: The dockur/windows repository delivers a Docker image for running full Windows operating systems inside containers. It features automatic ISO downloading, KVM hardware acceleration, and a web-based viewer. Supporting Windows 11, 10, servers, and older versions, it enables quick deployment via Docker Compose, CLI, or Kubernetes. Ideal for development/testing, legacy software support, and containerized Windows apps in cloud or Linux environments. Highlights include fully automated setup, performance acceleration, and broad DevOps integration.

repos.description: Run macOS VM in a Docker! Run near native OSX-KVM in Docker! X11 Forwarding! CI/CD for OS X Security Research! Docker mac Containers.
repos.summary_zh: Docker-OSX通过KVM和OpenCore技术实现在Docker容器中运行接近原生性能的macOS虚拟机。支持X11图形转发和iPhone USB设备穿透，专为macOS安全研究（如iMessage漏洞分析）和自动化CI/CD流程设计，提供便携且隔离的测试环境，显著提升安全研究员的工作效率。
repos.summary_en: Docker-OSX leverages KVM and OpenCore to run near-native macOS virtual machines inside Docker containers. It features X11 GUI forwarding and iPhone USB passthrough, specifically designed for macOS security research (including iMessage analysis) and CI/CD automation. This solution provides security researchers with a portable, isolated, and reproducible testing environment for efficient vulnerability discovery.

repos.description: 🗃 Open source self-hosted web archiving. Takes URLs/browser history/bookmarks/Pocket/Pinboard/etc., saves HTML, JS, PDFs, media, and more...
repos.summary_zh: ArchiveBox 是一款开源自托管网页存档工具，支持从浏览器书签、历史记录、Pocket、Pinboard 等多源导入 URL，完整保存 HTML、JS、PDF、媒体文件等内容。采用标准化格式（WARC、SQLite、JSON）确保数据长期可读，提供 CLI、REST API 和 Webhook 集成能力。适用于个人知识管理、企业证据保全及数字资产备份，支持 Docker 快速部署。
repos.summary_en: ArchiveBox is an open-source self-hosted web archiving solution that preserves web content from URLs, browser history, bookmarks, Pocket, Pinboard, and more. It captures comprehensive snapshots including HTML, JavaScript, PDFs, and media files in standardized formats (WARC, SQLite, JSON) ensuring long-term accessibility. The tool offers CLI, REST API, and webhook integrations for automation, with Docker support for easy deployment. Ideal for personal knowledge management, legal evidence preservation, and social media backup, it gives users full control over their archived data.

repos.description: Huly — All-in-One Project Management Platform (alternative to Linear, Jira, Slack, Notion, Motion)
repos.summary_zh: Huly Platform 是开源一体化项目管理平台，替代 Jira、Linear 等工具。提供 Chat、CRM、HRM、ATS 等模块化应用，支持自托管与 API 驱动开发。基于 Node.js 全栈框架，采用 Docker 容器化部署，加速企业级业务应用构建，实现多团队协作与流程自动化。
repos.summary_en: Huly Platform is an open-source all-in-one project management solution that replaces Jira, Linear, Slack, and Notion. It provides modular applications including Chat, CRM, HRM, and ATS with self-hosting capability. Built on a Node.js full-stack framework using Docker containerization, it accelerates enterprise business application development through API-driven integration and automated workflows for team collaboration.

repos.description: :rocket: The Ultimate Image Uploader for Efficient Creators. Supports Obsidian, Typora, VS Code etc. and 60+ image hosting services  (S3, GitHub, Cloudflare R2, Imgur, Aliyun OSS...). Paste, upload, done.
repos.summary_zh: PicGo是专为创作者设计的终极图片上传工具，无缝集成Obsidian、VS Code、Typora等主流编辑器。支持60+图床服务（GitHub、阿里云OSS、S3等），通过拖拽/粘贴/快捷键实现秒传并自动复制链接。独创插件系统可扩展支持Cloudflare R2等新兴存储，彻底消除写作中的上下文切换，让创作者专注内容生产。
repos.summary_en: PicGo is the ultimate image uploader for efficient creators, seamlessly integrating with Obsidian, VS Code, Typora and other editors. Supporting 60+ image hosts (GitHub, Alibaba Cloud OSS, AWS S3), it enables instant uploads via drag-and-drop/clipboard/hotkeys with auto-copied links. Its extensible plugin system adds support for Cloudflare R2 and more, eliminating context switching to maximize creative focus.

repos.description: Lightweight server monitoring with historical data, docker stats, and alerts.
repos.summary_zh: Beszel 是一款基于 PocketBase 的轻量级服务器监控平台，采用 hub-agent 架构。它提供 Docker 容器资源统计、历史数据追踪和自定义告警功能，支持多用户管理、OAuth 认证与自动备份。相比主流方案资源占用更低，具备友好 Web 界面，开箱即用，适合个人及小型团队监控物理服务器、虚拟机和容器化环境。
repos.summary_en: Beszel is a lightweight server monitoring platform built on PocketBase using a hub-agent architecture. It tracks Docker container metrics, historical data, and configurable alerts while supporting multi-user management, OAuth authentication, and automatic backups. With significantly lower resource consumption than leading solutions and an intuitive web interface, it's ideal for individuals and small teams monitoring physical servers, VMs, and containerized environments.

repos.description: 🥢像老乡鸡🐔那样做饭。已添加2026年发布的《老乡鸡菜品溯源报告 2.0中新出现的菜品。主要部分于2024年完工，非老乡鸡官方仓库。文字来自《老乡鸡菜品溯源报告》，并做归纳、编辑与整理。CookLikeHOC.
repos.summary_zh: 将老乡鸡标准化菜谱开源化，基于《老乡鸡菜品溯源报告》整理，提供可复制的家庭烹饪指南。技术亮点包括Docker容器化部署、AI手绘图解流程、网页端交互界面。核心价值在于中餐标准化与规模化烹饪方案的平民化，适合家庭烹饪爱好者与餐饮技术研究者。
repos.summary_en: This repository open-sources standardized recipes from Laoxiangji, compiled from their traceability reports to provide replicable home cooking guides. Technical highlights include Docker containerization, AI-generated hand-drawn illustrations, and a web interface. It democratizes Chinese restaurant-standardized cooking methods for home cooks and culinary tech enthusiasts.

repos.description: Why is this running? Trace any process, port, container, or file back to what started it - CLI + TUI.
repos.summary_zh: witr是一款跨平台系统诊断工具，专为回答“为什么在运行”而生。它通过CLI或交互式TUI，一键追溯任意进程、端口、容器或文件的完整启动因果链，覆盖systemd、Docker、PM2等监督层，输出人类可读报告或JSON，补全传统ps/lsof工具的因果盲区，助力运维与排障。
repos.summary_en: witr is a cross-platform diagnostic CLI+TUI tool that answers “Why is this running?”. It traces any process, port, container or file back to its full startup causality chain—including supervisors like systemd, Docker and PM2—delivering human-readable output or machine-readable JSON in one command, filling the gap left by traditional tools like ps and lsof.

repos.description: A self hosted virtual browser that runs in docker and uses WebRTC.
repos.summary_zh: Neko 是一款基于 Docker 的自托管虚拟浏览器，通过 WebRTC 实现低延迟桌面流传输。它提供安全隔离的浏览器环境，支持多用户同时访问，适用于隐私保护、团队协作和社交娱乐（如在线观影派对）。项目解决了传统共享方式（如 Discord）的崩溃问题，为远程互动提供稳定解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Neko is a self-hosted virtual browser running in Docker, streaming desktop via WebRTC. It offers a secure, isolated browsing environment with multi-user access, ideal for privacy protection, team collaboration, and social entertainment (e.g., watch parties). Designed to overcome instability of traditional sharing tools like Discord, it provides a stable, low-latency solution for remote interaction.

repos.description: Simple and easy to use DDNS. Support Aliyun, Tencent Cloud, Dnspod, Cloudflare, Callback, Huawei Cloud, Baidu Cloud, Porkbun, GoDaddy, Namecheap, NameSilo...
repos.summary_zh: ddns-go 是一款用Go开发的轻量级动态域名解析工具，支持阿里云、腾讯云、Cloudflare等20余家主流DNS服务商。可自动检测公网IPv4/IPv6地址变化并实时同步至域名记录，适用于家庭宽带、小型服务器等动态IP场景。提供Web管理界面、Docker部署方案及系统服务化运行能力，支持多平台、多架构与Webhook通知。
repos.summary_en: ddns-go is a lightweight Dynamic DNS client built with Golang, supporting 20+ major DNS providers like Aliyun, Tencent Cloud, Cloudflare and more. It automatically detects public IPv4/IPv6 address changes and synchronizes them to domain records in real-time, perfect for home broadband, small servers and IoT devices with dynamic IPs. The tool offers a user-friendly web interface, Docker deployment, system service integration, multi-platform compatibility (Windows/macOS/Linux, ARM/x86/RISC-V) and customizable webhook notifications.

repos.description: Self-hosted, plugin-based server management.
repos.summary_zh: Termix是一款开源自托管的Web服务器管理平台，为系统管理员提供一体化运维解决方案。核心功能包括：全功能SSH终端（支持分屏与标签页）、SSH隧道管理（自动重连与健康监测）、远程文件管理（支持代码/媒体编辑与Sudo权限）、Docker容器管控及服务器监控（CPU/内存/磁盘/防火墙）。采用React+Tailwind构建现代化响应式界面，支持RBAC权限体系、OIDC/2FA认证与SQLite数据库加密，是Termius的开源免费替代方案。
repos.summary_en: Termix is an open-source, self-hosted web platform for comprehensive server infrastructure management. It provides a full-featured SSH terminal with split-screen and tab support, automated SSH tunneling with health monitoring, and a remote file manager with sudo privileges. The platform integrates Docker container management, real-time server monitoring (CPU/memory/disk/network/firewall), and RBAC-based team collaboration. Built with React and Tailwind CSS, it features OIDC/2FA authentication, encrypted SQLite storage, and automatic SSL setup, serving as a free, all-in-one alternative to commercial solutions like Termius.

repos.description: The open-source, privacy-friendly CAPTCHA you host yourself. Bots and AI agents out, people in.
repos.summary_zh: Cap 是一款隐私优先的自托管验证码替代方案，采用 SHA-256 工作量证明机制，摒弃传统视觉 puzzles。仅 20KB 大小，零依赖，加载毫秒级，支持 Docker 独立部署。提供隐形验证与 M2M API 保护能力，通过 CSS 变量实现深度定制，为现代 Web 应用提供高效、私密的 bot 防护。
repos.summary_en: Cap is a privacy-first, self-hosted CAPTCHA alternative that replaces visual puzzles with SHA-256 proof-of-work challenges. At just 20KB with zero dependencies, it loads in milliseconds and supports standalone Docker deployment. Featuring invisible validation, M2M API protection, and CSS variable customization, it provides efficient, private bot mitigation for modern web applications.

repos.description: Email for professionals and teams
repos.summary_zh: Mailflare 是基于 Cloudflare 的自托管专业邮件收件箱，支持自定义域名。通过 Cloudflare Email Routing 与 Workers 实现收发邮件、附件、共享邮箱、路由规则、实时通知等完整功能。数据存于用户自有 D1 与 R2，可一键部署或 Docker 自建，适合个人与团队低成本掌控企业邮箱。
repos.summary_en: Mailflare is a self-hosted professional email inbox for custom domains built on Cloudflare. It leverages Email Routing and Workers for full-featured send/receive with attachments, shared mailboxes, routing rules, real-time notifications and more. Data stays in your own D1 and R2. One-click deploy or Docker self-host, ideal for individuals and teams seeking low-cost control of business email.

repos.description: An open-source vibe coding platform that helps you build your own vibe-coding platform, built entirely on Cloudflare stack
repos.summary_zh: Cloudflare VibeSDK 是基于 Cloudflare 全栈生态的开源 AI 应用生成平台。它允许企业通过自然语言描述自动生成 React+TS+Tailwind 应用，并一键部署至 Workers。核心亮点包括 AI 智能纠错、沙箱实时预览、多 LLM 网关集成，以及可定制的组件库支持，适用于构建内部工具、SaaS 扩展和客户赋能平台。
repos.summary_en: Cloudflare VibeSDK is an open-source AI-powered full-stack app generator built entirely on Cloudflare's developer platform. It enables natural language-driven React+TypeScript+Tailwind application creation with one-click deployment to Workers. Key features include AI error correction, sandboxed live previews, multi-LLM gateway integration, and customizable component libraries—ideal for internal tools, SaaS extensions, and customer-facing AI platforms.

repos.description: Image Hosting solution, Flickr/imgur alternative, make it easy for users to share their images. Using Cloudflare Pages and Telegraph.
repos.summary_zh: Telegraph-Image 是基于 Cloudflare Pages 和 Telegram Channel 的免费图床方案，替代 Flickr/imgur。核心价值：无限存储（单图5MB限制）、零服务器成本、自动绑定 pages.dev 域名或自定义域名。技术亮点包括可选 AI 图片审查、后台管理（网格/瀑布流视图）、批量删除与分页功能，完全依赖 Cloudflare 免费额度运营。
repos.summary_en: Telegraph-Image is a free image hosting solution using Cloudflare Pages and Telegram Channel as a Flickr/imgur alternative. Key value: unlimited storage (5MB/image cap), zero server cost, automatic *.pages.dev domain or custom domain binding. Technical highlights include optional AI image moderation, backend management (grid/waterfall views), batch operations, and full operation within Cloudflare's free tier limits.

repos.description: 自建 Docker 镜像加速与管理服务。零磁盘缓存、可视化面板、支持上游账号认证，支持一键部署Docker、K8s、Quay、Ghcr、Mcr、elastic、nvcr等镜像加速
repos.summary_zh: 该项目提供一键部署的Docker镜像加速服务，基于官方Registry支持Docker Hub、K8s、Quay等主流仓库代理。支持自动配置反向代理（Nginx/Caddy）、缓存控制、IP黑白名单及私有镜像拉取，解决国内镜像下载慢和频率限制问题。可部署在自有服务器或ClawCloud/Render等免费平台，附带Web管理面板实现镜像搜索与容器监控。
repos.summary_en: This project provides a one-click deployable Docker image acceleration service based on the official Registry, supporting proxies for Docker Hub, K8s, Quay, and other major registries. It features automatic reverse proxy (Nginx/Caddy) setup, cache control, IP whitelisting/blacklisting, and private image pulling to address slow downloads and rate limits in China. It can be deployed on private servers or free platforms like ClawCloud/Render, with a web management panel for image search and container monitoring.

repos.description: Bitwarden-compatible server running on Cloudflare Workers
repos.summary_zh: NodeWarden 是基于 Cloudflare Workers 的第三方 Bitwarden 兼容服务端，实现零成本自托管密码管理。支持多用户、附件存储、TOTP 及 Passkey 等核心功能，兼容全平台官方客户端。利用 R2/KV 存储保障数据安全，适合个人及小团队私有化部署，规避企业版订阅费用。
repos.summary_en: NodeWarden is a third-party Bitwarden-compatible server deployed on Cloudflare Workers, enabling zero-cost self-hosted password management. It supports multi-user access, attachments, TOTP, and Passkey features while maintaining full compatibility with official clients across platforms. Leveraging R2/KV storage for data security, it's ideal for individuals and small teams seeking private deployment without enterprise subscription fees.

repos.description: Virtual DSM in a Docker container.
repos.summary_zh: vdsm/virtual-dsm 是一个创新的轻量级 NAS 解决方案，通过在 Docker 容器中虚拟化运行 Synology DSM 系统，结合 KVM 硬件加速技术实现接近原生的性能表现。项目支持多磁盘管理、物理设备直通、CPU 与内存灵活配置，可快速部署于 Linux、Windows 和 macOS 平台，适用于个人私有云存储、开发测试环境及轻量级生产场景。
repos.summary_en: vdsm/virtual-dsm is an innovative lightweight NAS solution that virtualizes Synology DSM within Docker containers, leveraging KVM hardware acceleration to deliver near-native performance. This project provides comprehensive storage virtualization capabilities including multi-disk management, raw device passthrough, and dynamic resource allocation for CPU and memory. With support for Docker Compose, Kubernetes, and GitHub Codespaces, it enables rapid deployment across Linux, Windows, and macOS platforms. The solution is particularly suited for personal cloud storage, development testing environments, and scenarios requiring flexible, containerized NAS infrastructure with enterprise-grade features.

repos.description: The RethinkDNS resolver that deploys to Cloudflare Workers, Deno Deploy, Fastly, and Fly.io
repos.summary_zh: Serverless-dns 是一个自托管的无服务器 DNS 解析器，提供类似 Pi-Hole 的内容过滤功能，支持 DNS-over-HTTPS 和 DNS-over-TLS。它可一键部署到 Cloudflare Workers、Deno Deploy、Fastly 和 Fly.io 等边缘平台，利用其免费层即可满足10-20台设备的日常需求。服务器处理延迟仅0-2毫秒，端到端延迟中位数为10-30毫秒，具备全球覆盖能力。
repos.summary_en: Serverless-dns is a self-hosted, serverless DNS resolver with Pi-Hole-like content blocking, supporting DNS-over-HTTPS (DoH) and DNS-over-TLS (DoT). It deploys effortlessly to edge platforms including Cloudflare Workers, Deno Deploy, Fastly, and Fly.io. The free tiers suffice for 10-20 devices monthly. Server processing takes 0-2ms, with end-to-end latency of 10-30ms (median), enabling global low-latency DNS resolution.

repos.description: An index & manager of Onedrive based on serverless. Can be deployed to Vercel/Heroku/SCF/FG/FC/CFC/PHP web hosting/VPS.
repos.summary_zh: 一个基于Serverless架构的Onedrive文件管理器，支持Vercel、Heroku及国内云函数平台部署。通过生成直链实现用户直传直下载，大幅节省服务器带宽成本。提供可视化文件管理界面，支持多用户、多目录，适用于个人云盘分享、团队文档协作及静态资源托管场景。
repos.summary_en: A serverless-based OneDrive index and manager that enables seamless deployment across Vercel, Heroku, and major Chinese cloud function platforms including Tencent SCF, Huawei FG, Alibaba FC, and Baidu CFC. The system generates direct URLs allowing end-users to upload and download files directly through Microsoft's infrastructure, minimizing server bandwidth consumption to near zero. With an intuitive web interface supporting multi-user access and directory management, it transforms OneDrive into a fully functional cloud storage portal suitable for personal file sharing, team collaboration, and static website hosting. Its PHP implementation ensures broad compatibility with various hosting environments while maintaining low operational costs.

repos.description: ✦ Gemini ➜ OpenAI API proxy. Serverless!
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是一个OpenAI API格式的代理，将请求转发至Google Gemini API。利用Gemini免费层的慷慨额度，让仅支持OpenAI接口的开发者工具无缝切换至Gemini模型。支持Vercel、Netlify、Cloudflare Workers等Serverless平台一键部署，无需服务器维护，同时提供Node、Deno、Bun本地运行方案，突破地域限制。
repos.summary_en: This project provides a serverless proxy that translates OpenAI API requests to Google Gemini API format. By leveraging Gemini's generous free tier, it enables developers to use OpenAI-exclusive tools with Gemini models at zero cost. Supports one-click deployment to Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare Workers, and Deno Deploy without server maintenance. Offers local development via Node, Deno, or Bun, allowing users outside supported regions to obtain API keys via VPN and access Gemini's powerful models seamlessly.

repos.description: A calm, open system for organizing life and work. Tasks, projects, notes, areas, and smart workflows - self-hosted or hosted.
repos.summary_zh: tududi是一款自托管任务管理工具，融合个人简洁性与专业项目组织能力。核心亮点包括智能递归任务系统（支持多种模式、完成触发机制）、Telegram集成、多层级结构（领域-项目-任务-子任务），以及24种语言支持。面向注重隐私与效率的个人及团队，提供开放API与响应式设计，实现数据自主可控的生产力提升。
repos.summary_en: tududi is a self-hosted task management tool that merges personal simplicity with professional project organization. Its core features include an intelligent recurring task system with multiple patterns and completion-based triggers, seamless Telegram integration, and a hierarchical structure (Areas > Projects > Tasks > Subtasks). Designed for privacy-conscious individuals and teams, it offers 24-language support, OpenAPI documentation, and responsive design for full data control and productivity across devices.

repos.summary_zh: RKNN-Toolkit2是Rockchip NPU的完整AI部署工具链，支持模型转换、推理与性能评估。提供C/Python API，覆盖RK3588/RV1106等多款芯片，具备自动混合精度与图优化能力，助力边缘AI应用快速落地。包含Toolkit、Runtime及Lite版本，支持Python 3.6-3.12，是嵌入式AI开发的核心基础设施，不兼容旧版RKNN-Toolkit。
repos.summary_en: RKNN-Toolkit2 is a complete AI deployment toolchain for Rockchip NPU platforms, enabling model conversion, inference and performance evaluation. It provides both C and Python APIs, supporting multiple chips including RK3588 and RV1106 series. Key features include automatic mixed precision, enhanced graph optimization, and compatibility with Python 3.6-3.12. The toolkit accelerates edge AI application development on embedded devices and is not compatible with the legacy RKNN-Toolkit, requiring migration for new projects.

repos.description: 提升部署在cloudflare、vercel或netlify的网页在中国的访问速度和稳定性   cf优选域名 | cf优选ip | cloudflare | vercel | netlify | 加速 | 国内 | 中国 | 境内 | 大陆
repos.summary_zh: 该项目通过自定义CNAME解析，优化Cloudflare、Vercel和Netlify服务在中国大陆的访问体验。核心机制是定时测试各平台IP的速度与稳定性，优选出最佳节点并配置三网解析，将国内流量引导至最优线路，海外使用官方IP。相比官方Anycast常将流量路由至东南亚导致拥堵，此方案能有效改善晚高峰时段的访问速度和连通性稳定性，仅需修改DNS记录即可实现，特别适合部署在海外FaaS平台的中文网站加速。
repos.summary_en: This project enhances access speed and stability for websites hosted on Cloudflare, Vercel, or Netlify in mainland China through custom CNAME redirection. It automatically tests IPs from these platforms every 40 minutes, selecting optimal nodes for China's three major ISPs while using official IPs overseas. By bypassing problematic anycast routing that often directs Chinese traffic to Southeast Asia, it significantly improves connectivity during peak hours and prevents single-point failures. The solution requires only DNS configuration changes, making it ideal for accelerating Chinese access to overseas serverless deployments.

repos.description: 🌩️ Serverless 自托管的文件管理与文本分享工具/网盘，支持多存储聚合管理和WebDAV 服务挂载。兼容 S3、WebDAV、OneDrive、Google Drive、Telegram、HF、GitHub 等。内置   Markdown 编辑器、30+文件格式预览。支持 Cloudflare Workers 或 Docker 部署。
repos.summary_zh: CloudPaste 是一款基于 Cloudflare Workers 的 Serverless 自托管网盘，核心价值在于多云存储聚合管理与零运维部署。支持 S3、OneDrive、Google Drive 等 30+ 存储后端，提供统一 WebDAV 挂载。内置 Vditor Markdown 编辑器与 30+ 文件格式预览，实现个人知识库管理与团队协作。通过边缘计算实现全球加速，Docker 部署提供本地灵活性。
repos.summary_en: CloudPaste is a Serverless self-hosted cloud storage built on Cloudflare Workers, aggregating 30+ storage backends including S3, OneDrive, and Google Drive with unified WebDAV mounting. It features a Vditor Markdown editor, 30+ file format previews, and edge computing acceleration across 300+ global nodes. Offering zero-maintenance deployment via Workers or Docker, it serves as an ideal solution for personal knowledge management and team collaboration.

repos.description: Google Antigravity AI模型配额监控插件 (Antigravity AI Model Quota Watching)
repos.summary_zh: AntigravityQuotaWatcher 是一款 VS Code 插件，专为 Antigravity AI 平台用户提供实时配额监控。通过自动检测服务端口与认证信息，在状态栏直观展示各模型剩余配额，并在配额不足时智能预警。内置 Dashboard 面板支持配额概览、连接状态检测及周限测试，帮助开发者有效管理 AI 资源，避免开发中断。
repos.summary_en: AntigravityQuotaWatcher is a VS Code extension that provides real-time quota monitoring for Antigravity AI platform users. It automatically detects service ports and authentication credentials, displays remaining quotas for various AI models in the status bar, and offers smart alerts when quotas are low. The built-in Dashboard panel provides quota overview, connection status, and weekly limit testing features, helping developers effectively manage AI resources and prevent development interruptions.

repos.description: Warp+Psiphon, an anti censorship utility for iran
repos.summary_zh: Warp-Plus是基于Cloudflare Warp的开源实现，深度集成Psiphon链式代理，专为伊朗等高审查环境打造的抗审查工具。支持Warp-in-Warp双层隧道改变虚拟NAT位置、SOCKS5代理、端点扫描与跨平台部署（含Termux），提供快速、安全且灵活的翻墙VPN解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Warp-Plus is an open-source Cloudflare Warp implementation enhanced with Psiphon chaining for robust censorship circumvention in restrictive regions like Iran. It features Warp-in-Warp dual tunneling to shift virtual NAT locations, SOCKS5 proxy support, endpoint scanning, and cross-platform compatibility including Termux, delivering a fast, secure VPN solution for unrestricted internet access.

repos.summary_zh: 基于 Cloudflare Pages 和 Next.js 的 Serverless 图床服务。利用 Cloudflare 免费额度实现无限存储且零成本运营，无需自备服务器和域名。集成内容审核 API 自动屏蔽不良图片，提供完整的后台管理系统，支持访问统计、黑白名单管控，并可配置 Telegram 机器人实时通知。
repos.summary_en: A Serverless image hosting service built on Cloudflare Pages and Next.js. Offers unlimited storage at zero cost within Cloudflare's free tier, eliminating the need for self-hosted servers and domains. Features automated content moderation API for inappropriate images, a full-featured admin panel with access analytics, IP/referer whitelisting/blacklisting, and configurable Telegram bot notifications.

repos.description: A golang implementation of endlessh (SSH tarpit) exporting Prometheus metrics, visualized by a Grafana dashboard.
repos.summary_zh: 基于Go实现的SSH tarpit（endlessh），通过故意延迟响应浪费暴力破解攻击者时间，并导出Prometheus指标，配合Grafana仪表板可视化攻击源地理位置与统计数据。适用于SSH安全防护与威胁情报场景，支持Docker部署、GeoIP查询、健康检查，轻量高效且可观测性强。
repos.summary_en: A Golang implementation of endlessh (SSH tarpit) that delays responses to waste brute-force attackers' time while exporting Prometheus metrics, visualized via a Grafana dashboard showing geolocations and attack statistics. Ideal for SSH defense and threat intelligence, with Docker support, GeoIP lookup, and health checks.

repos.description: 🚀 Full-stack Next.js 15 + Cloudflare Workers template with D1 database, R2 storage, Better Auth, and Server Actions. Production-ready with automated CI/CD and generous free tiers.
repos.summary_zh: 该模板深度融合 Next.js 15 与 Cloudflare Workers 边缘计算平台，提供生产级全栈解决方案。核心亮点包括 D1 分布式 SQLite 数据库、R2 对象存储、Better Auth 认证体系及 Server Actions 数据交互，通过 Drizzle ORM 实现端到端类型安全。内置 GitHub Actions 自动化流水线与预览部署，充分利用 Cloudflare 免费层实现低成本启动，支持从 MVP 到企业级应用的无缝扩展。
repos.summary_en: This production-ready template integrates Next.js 15 with Cloudflare Workers edge computing, delivering a full-stack solution featuring D1 distributed SQLite database, R2 object storage, Better Auth authentication, and Server Actions. With end-to-end TypeScript via Drizzle ORM, automated CI/CD via GitHub Actions, and preview deployments, it leverages Cloudflare's generous free tier for cost-effective MVP development while scaling seamlessly to enterprise applications.

repos.description: 一个基于 NextJS + Cloudflare 技术栈构建的可爱消息推送服务, 支持多种消息推送渠道✨
repos.summary_zh: MoePush 是基于 Next.js 与 Cloudflare 全栈构建的开源消息推送服务，支持钉钉、企业微信、Telegram 等十余种渠道。项目采用边缘计算架构，通过 Cloudflare Pages 与 D1 数据库实现零成本部署，提供接口组批量推送能力。UI 基于 shadcn/ui 打造，兼具美观与易用性，适用于监控告警、自动化通知等场景。
repos.summary_en: MoePush is an open-source, adorable message push service built on Next.js and Cloudflare stack, supporting over 10 channels including DingTalk, WeCom, Telegram, and more. Leveraging edge computing architecture with Cloudflare Pages and D1 database, it enables zero-cost deployment and batch push via group interfaces. The UI, crafted with shadcn/ui, combines aesthetics with usability. Ideal for monitoring alerts and automated notifications, it offers a developer-friendly solution with GitHub OAuth integration and seamless deployment.

repos.description: Vocat is an open-source web control panel and engineering toolkit for Quectel EC20/EC25-class cellular modems. It combines modem discovery, live radio status, AT and USSD terminals, SMS, WiFi Calling, eSIM management, network selection, proxy routing, notifications, audit logs, and release automation in one self-contained service.
repos.summary_zh: Vocat 是开源的移远 EC20/EC25 蜂窝模组 Web 管理面板，集成模组发现、射频监控、AT/USSD 终端、短信、WiFi Calling、eSIM 管理、网络选择与代理路由，Go+React 单二进制部署，支持多架构 Docker。
repos.summary_en: Vocat is an open-source web control panel for Quectel EC20/EC25 cellular modems, integrating modem discovery, radio monitoring, AT/USSD terminals, SMS, WiFi Calling, eSIM management, network selection, and proxy routing. Built with Go and React, it deploys as a single binary with multi-arch Docker support.

repos.description: Selfhost web archiving and sharing service.
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Cloudflare 的免费网页归档服务，通过浏览器插件将页面保存为单文件 HTML，利用 Worker+D1+R2 全栈方案实现低成本存储与检索。集成 AI 自动标签分类、文件夹管理与阅读模式，支持移动端适配，提供完整的归档、搜索与分享功能，适合个人知识沉淀。
repos.summary_en: Web Archive is a free, serverless web archiving and sharing service built entirely on Cloudflare's platform. It captures webpages as single-file HTML through a browser extension and stores them using Cloudflare D1 database and R2 storage via Workers. The platform features AI-powered automatic tag classification, folder organization, reading mode, mobile responsiveness, and searchable archives. Leveraging Cloudflare's generous free tier, it provides a cost-effective, scalable solution for personal knowledge management and digital content preservation.

repos.description: 👏 Make learning a lifelong habit. 学无止境
repos.summary_zh: my-geektime 是极客时间VIP课程的音视频私有化部署系统。支持一次缓存永久观看，一键发布课程为在线文档，以及本地音视频下载。基于Docker容器化技术，提供跨平台部署能力，实现学习资源的离线管理与在线访问，适合构建个人终身学习知识库。
repos.summary_en: my-geektime is a self-hosted GeekTime VIP course platform specializing in audio/video resource management. It enables permanent offline viewing through one-time caching, one-click online documentation publishing, and local media downloads. Built with Docker containerization for cross-platform deployment (amd64/arm64), it transforms streaming content into private learning assets. This tool eliminates dependency on official servers, providing lifelong access to purchased courses while maintaining content organization, search capabilities, and seamless playback functionality for individual learners.

repos.description: 🚀 OpenAI-compatible Freebuff proxy with dynamic free-agent tracking, token rotation, and ready-to-use Docker deployment.
repos.summary_zh: Freebuff2API 是一个 OpenAI 兼容代理服务器，将 Freebuff 免费 AI 模型转换为标准 OpenAI API 格式。支持多账号 token 自动轮换提升调用额度，动态模拟官方 SDK 指纹规避检测，并提供 Docker 快速部署。适用于开发者在不更换现有 OpenAI SDK 代码的前提下，零成本调用 Freebuff 的 AI 模型服务。
repos.summary_en: Freebuff2API is an OpenAI-compatible proxy server that transforms Freebuff's free AI models into standard OpenAI API endpoints. It features automatic multi-token rotation for higher throughput, dynamic client fingerprinting to mimic official SDK behavior, and Docker deployment. Enables developers to use Freebuff's AI services with any OpenAI-compatible client without code changes.

repos.description: Grok2API (Cloudflare Workers) one-click deploy with auto D1+KV provisioning
repos.summary_zh: 基于 FastAPI 重构的 Grok AI 代理 API，全面适配最新 Web 调用格式。支持流式/非流式对话、图像生成与深度思考，内置号池并发与自动负载均衡机制。提供 Cloudflare Workers 无服务器部署方案，集成 D1 数据库与 KV 存储。具备可视化后台管理、自动注册、Token 状态智能判定等企业级功能，实现多端部署一致性。
repos.summary_en: FastAPI-based proxy API for Grok AI, fully adapted to the latest web calling format. Supports streaming/non-streaming conversations, image generation/editing, and deep thinking with built-in account pool concurrency and auto load balancing. Offers Cloudflare Workers serverless deployment with D1 database and KV storage integration. Features visual admin panel, auto-registration with Turnstile solver, intelligent token status detection, and consistent behavior across local, Docker, and serverless deployments.

repos.description: Self-hosted SIM/eSIM gateway for VoWiFi calling, SMS, cellular data and isolated regional egress
repos.summary_zh: MDD Sim Gateway 是面向 Debian/Ubuntu/Armbian ARM64 的自托管多 SIM/eSIM 通信网关。它整合蜂窝模块、USB 读卡器、IMS、EAP-AKA、ModemManager 与 sing-box，通过中英文 Web 控制台实现真实 SIM 鉴权（不读取 Ki/OP）、浏览器软电话通话与短信、多模块统一管理及独立国家出口 TUN，UDP 失败时不泄漏。适用于自建 VoWiFi、隔离区域网络出口与运营商线路保号场景。
repos.summary_en: MDD Sim Gateway is a self-hosted multi-SIM/eSIM communication gateway for Debian/Ubuntu/Armbian ARM64. It integrates cellular modules, USB readers, IMS, EAP-AKA, ModemManager and sing-box into a bilingual web console, enabling real SIM authentication (no Ki/OP exposure), browser softphone calls/SMS, multi-module management and isolated country egress TUNs that never leak on UDP failure. Ideal for self-hosted VoWiFi, regional network isolation and carrier line keepalive.

repos.description: A Powerful Serverless Uptime Monitoring & Status Page on Cloudflare's Edge Network
repos.summary_zh: Uptimer是基于Cloudflare边缘网络的无服务器运行时间监控与状态页面系统。支持HTTP/TCP探测、故障事件管理、维护窗口、Webhook通知（Discord/Slack等）及管理后台，零运维部署于Workers+Pages+D1，实现实时状态展示与告警。
repos.summary_en: Uptimer is a serverless uptime monitoring and status page running on Cloudflare's edge network. It offers HTTP/TCP probes, incident management, maintenance windows, webhook alerts (Discord/Slack/etc.), and an admin dashboard, all deployed zero-ops via Workers + Pages + D1 for real-time status and notifications.

repos.description: An out‑of‑the‑box Next.js + Cloudflare full‑stack starter integrating Edge Runtime, D1 database, R2 storage, KV cache, Analytics Engine hooks, and a complete CI/CD pipeline.一个开箱即用的 Next.js + Cloudflare 全栈项目模板，集成 Edge Runtime、D1 数据库、R2 存储和完整的 CI/CD 流程。
repos.summary_zh: 一个开箱即用的Next.js + Cloudflare全栈模板，专为边缘计算场景打造。基于vinext实现4倍构建加速和57%包体积缩减，深度集成D1数据库、R2存储、KV缓存和Analytics Engine。内置better-auth认证、next-intl国际化、Vitest测试和完整CI/CD流水线，提供生产级环境变量验证、结构化日志和自动化迁移验证。适用于需要高性能、低成本、全球部署的现代化Web应用开发。
repos.summary_en: Production-ready Next.js + Cloudflare full-stack starter for edge computing. Leverages vinext for 4x faster builds and 57% smaller bundles, deeply integrating D1 database, R2 storage, KV cache, and Analytics Engine. Features better-auth authentication, next-intl i18n, Vitest testing, and complete CI/CD pipeline with production-grade environment validation, structured logging, and automated migration verification. Ideal for high-performance, low-cost, globally-deployed modern web applications.

repos.description: Two Factor Authentication
repos.summary_zh: 基于Cloudflare Workers的全球加速网络，提供安全便捷的两步验证密钥管理服务。支持TOTP/HOTP自动生成、二维码扫描/图片识别添加、AES-256加密存储，兼容Google Authenticator等多平台导入导出，具备PWA离线使用与WebDAV/S3远程备份能力，适用于个人与企业多设备场景。
repos.summary_en: A secure two-factor authentication (2FA) key management service leveraging Cloudflare Workers for global acceleration. Features include automatic TOTP/HOTP generation, QR code scanning/image recognition for key addition, AES-256 encryption, and seamless import/export from platforms like Google Authenticator. With PWA offline support and remote backup via WebDAV/S3/OneDrive/Google Drive, it provides a unified solution across mobile, tablet, and desktop devices.

repos.summary_zh: HiDeck 是一款自托管的 Qualcomm 4G/LTE/5G 调制解调器管理控制台，通过浏览器统一管理 USB 蜂窝模块，支持代理绑定、短信收发、WiFi 通话、VoLTE、eSIM 管理及定时任务自动化，采用 Go + Vue 3 构建，Docker 一键部署。
repos.summary_en: HiDeck is a self-hosted web console for managing Qualcomm 4G/LTE/5G cellular modems through a browser interface. It supports USB modem auto-discovery across QMI, MBIM, AT, and PC/SC protocols, SOCKS5/HTTP proxy binding, SMS inbox and sending, WiFi calling, native VoLTE, eSIM provisioning, and scheduled task automation with notifications via Telegram, email, Bark, Feishu, and WeChat. Built with Go and Vue 3, it deploys via Docker with SQLite storage, supporting both binary and containerized installation for Linux systems with multi-language documentation.

repos.description: 智谱清言网页版的 Cloudflare Worker 2API层，提供 OpenAI / Claude / Gemini 三种协议兼容接口，支持流式对话、Tools调用、AI 绘图、视频生成与多账号 Token 轮询。
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个将智谱清言私有API转换为标准LLM接口的Cloudflare Worker服务。核心价值在于提供OpenAI、Claude、Gemini三协议兼容，支持流式对话、Tools调用、AI绘图与视频生成。通过动态Token轮询和自动补号机制，实现多账号资源池化与零维护，让任意兼容客户端无缝调用GLM系列模型能力。
repos.summary_en: This Cloudflare Worker service converts ChatGLM's private streaming API into standardized LLM service interfaces, delivering seamless OpenAI, Claude, and Gemini protocol compatibility. Key features include streaming responses with reasoning content, dynamic token management with round-robin scheduling, automated token replenishment, and support for AI drawing, video generation, and function calling. The architecture separates authentication from resource tokens, enabling unified management of multiple accounts while providing zero-maintenance operation for any compatible client applications.

repos.description: 每天早上打开通知，高质量论文摘要已经为你准备好 Ciallo～(∠・ω< )⌒☆
repos.summary_zh: 基于LLM的学术论文自动化监控系统，每日从ArXiv及20+顶级期刊抓取最新论文，通过双模型加权评分精准筛选，深度解析PDF全文并提取创新点、方法等核心维度。自动追踪关键词趋势生成可视化报告，支持邮件/企微等多渠道推送。提供Docker、GitHub Actions等部署方案，实现零人工干预的科研情报服务。
repos.summary_en: An LLM-powered academic paper monitoring system that automatically fetches daily submissions from ArXiv and 20+ top journals. It employs dual-model weighted scoring for precise filtering, performs in-depth PDF analysis to extract key dimensions like methodologies and innovations, tracks keyword trends with visual reports, and pushes notifications via email/WeCom等多渠道. Supports Docker/GitHub Actions deployments for fully automated research intelligence.

repos.description: 基于 Cookie/Token 认证、自动绕过 Cloudflare (CF) 人机验证、高级反检测伪装、高速流式 API 转换、Docker 一键部署
repos.summary_zh: notion-2api 是一个将 Notion AI 非官方接口转换为 OpenAI 兼容格式的高性能代理层。基于 FastAPI 和 cloudscraper 实现 Cloudflare 绕过与反检测，支持流式响应和多模型调用。Docker 一键部署让任意 OpenAI API 客户端无缝接入 Notion AI 能力，适用于自动化脚本、AI 应用集成等场景。
repos.summary_en: notion-2api is a high-performance proxy service that transforms Notion AI's unofficial backend into a fully compatible OpenAI API interface. Leveraging FastAPI and cloudscraper, it automatically bypasses Cloudflare protection while implementing advanced anti-detection mechanisms. The solution supports real-time streaming responses (stream=true) and maintains session state across multiple models. With Docker-based deployment, developers can instantly provision a private API endpoint, enabling any OpenAI-compatible application or script to harness Notion AI's capabilities without official API access.

repos.description: Open-source network quality monitoring platform with multi-node Ping, TCPing, HTTP, DNS, IPv6 and Traceroute testing.
repos.summary_zh: 开源多节点网络质量监控平台，支持Ping/TCPing/HTTP/DNS/Traceroute/IPv6探测。采用Master+Agent+RabbitMQ架构，基于RuoYi-Vue-Plus、Next.js与Prometheus Blackbox，提供Agent自动上下线、一键部署、IP地理解析及广告系统，助力企业低成本搭建网络运维与测速平台。
repos.summary_en: Open-source multi-node network quality monitoring platform supporting Ping, TCPing, HTTP, DNS, Traceroute and IPv6. Built with Master+Agent+RabbitMQ architecture using RuoYi-Vue-Plus, Next.js and Prometheus Blackbox. Features auto Agent management, one-click deployment, IP geolocation and ad system for low-cost enterprise network ops.

repos.description: Shadowfetch is a lightweight fetcher built with native TCP Sockets, for Cloudflare Workers.
repos.summary_zh: Shadowfetch 是 Cloudflare Workers 的隐私优先网络请求库，通过原生 TCP 套接字绕过内置 fetch 的元数据泄露问题。核心功能包括自动剥离 cf-ipcountry、cf-connecting-ip 等敏感头信息，确保用户 IP 与地理位置不被意外暴露。适用于需严格隐私保护的代理、镜像或数据转发场景，提供轻量级、可控的请求控制能力。
repos.summary_en: Shadowfetch is a privacy-focused fetcher for Cloudflare Workers that leverages native TCP sockets to prevent metadata leakage from built-in fetch. It sanitizes sensitive headers like cf-ipcountry and cf-connecting-ip, ensuring user IP and geolocation remain hidden. Ideal for privacy-sensitive proxying, mirroring, and data forwarding with minimal overhead and maximum control.

repos.description: OneDrive public directory listing, and One-Click Deploy to Vercel. Powered by Vercel and Next.js.
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Next.js 和 Vercel 的 OneDrive 目录列表程序，支持一键部署。通过将配置迁移至 Vercel 环境变量，省去手动修改配置文件的繁琐步骤，实现快速上线。提供文件预览、下载功能，支持文件夹密码保护，并优化 OAuth 认证流程以增强安全性，适合免费搭建私有文件分享站点。
repos.summary_en: A OneDrive directory listing solution built with Next.js and Vercel, featuring one-click deployment. By migrating configurations to Vercel environment variables, it eliminates manual config file editing, enabling rapid setup. Offers file preview and download capabilities, supports password-protected folders, and enhances OAuth security by auto-closing authentication channels.

repos.description: 极简 Cloudflare Worker，接收私人域名邮件并提供 HTTP API 读取
repos.summary_zh: ni-mail 是一个极简 Cloudflare Worker，通过 Email Routing 接收私人域名邮件并提供 HTTP API 读取。使用 KV 存储最多 50 封邮件，postal-mime 解析为结构化 JSON，支持 API Key 鉴权和多自定义域名，附件仅存 metadata。无需数据库、前端或 JWT，部署简单，适合自动化脚本获取邮件内容，实现轻量级邮件集成。
repos.summary_en: ni-mail is a minimalist Cloudflare Worker that receives private domain emails via Cloudflare Email Routing and exposes them through a simple HTTP API. It stores up to 50 emails in KV, parses them with postal-mime into structured JSON, supports API key auth and multiple custom domains, and keeps only attachment metadata. No database, frontend or JWT needed; ideal for automation scripts fetching emails in a lightweight, serverless setup.

repos.description: 一个基于 Next.js 开发的全栈 Docker 镜像仓库管理私服，支持一键部署到Vercel。解决国内 Pull 镜像困难问题。
repos.summary_zh: Pocker 是基于 Next.js 的全栈 Docker 镜像仓库管理系统，专为解决国内 Docker Hub 拉取缓慢而设计。系统通过 GitHub Actions 自动化将镜像转存至华为云 SWR，支持一键 Vercel 部署、多区域节点切换、镜像/标签/命名空间全生命周期管理，并提供用量统计与暗黑模式。让每个人都能拥有自主可控的 Docker 私服。
repos.summary_en: Pocker is a full-stack Docker registry management system built with Next.js, designed to solve slow Docker Hub pulls in China. It automatically transfers images to Huawei Cloud SWR via GitHub Actions, enabling one-click Vercel deployment. Key features include multi-region node switching (23 global nodes), complete lifecycle management of images/tags/namespaces, usage statistics, dark mode, and automated workflows. It empowers individuals and teams to own private Docker registries with full data control and security.

repos.description: Panel.NA1 持续赚取金币
repos.summary_zh: 该项目利用 HuggingFace Spaces 免费托管服务，实现 Panel.NA1 平台的 24/7 自动化挂机赚金币。核心特性包括每分钟自动签到、Cookie 自动刷新、Web 监控面板及抗休眠保活机制，支持 Telegram 通知。零成本部署，适用于个人资源获取与无服务器自动化技术实践，通过反代解决网络限制。
repos.summary_en: This project leverages HuggingFace Spaces free hosting to automate 24/7 coin farming on Panel.NA1 platform. Key features include automatic check-in every minute, cookie auto-refresh, web monitoring dashboard, anti-idle keep-alive mechanism, and Telegram notifications via reverse proxy. Zero-cost deployment suits personal resource acquisition and serverless automation learning, effectively overcoming network restrictions while maintaining persistent operation through external health checks.
